newsitem.title: USA: MCI to expand local phone service.
newsitem.headline: MCI to expand local phone service.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said Thursday it would offer switched local service in six new markets.

They are the Disctrict of Columbia, Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, Cincinnati and Fort Lauderdale, Fla. The additions will bring to 31 the number of major markets where the nation's No. 2 long-distance carrier offers facilities-based local phone service.
The company also told a press conference here that it plans to "dramatically broaden" the reach of its local switched networks in New York City, Baltimore and Seattle.
And MCI will start statewide resale service to residential customers in Illinois and New York, adding to its current residential offering in California.
